user.title: Sync two to-do lists
user.description: Items are matched by name. List A may be a list that cannot keep checked-off items (such as the Alexa shopping list): an item disappearing there is checked off in list B, and checking it off in list B checks it off in list A. A new pair only previews until you switch on syncing in its options.

error.list_unavailable: A selected list is unavailable right now; try again once it has loaded
error.list_unsupported: A selected list cannot add and update items
error.list_in_use: A selected list is already part of another pair; each list can be in one pair only

abort.already_configured: These two lists are already synced

init.title: Sync options
init.description: While syncing is off the pair only previews: the lists are read and the planned changes are shown on the Last sync sensor, nothing is written.

sync_now.name: Sync now
sync_now.description: Sync list pairs immediately (all pairs, or the selected one).

config_entry_id.name: Pair
config_entry_id.description: Only sync this pair. Required with force.

force.name: Force
force.description: Also sync when items would be checked off because they went missing on the other list in large numbers or because that list reads as empty (normally treated as an outage). Only for the selected pair, admins only.

preview.name: Preview
preview.description: Show what a sync would change now, without writing anything.
